name: Gary Lineker's Hot-Shot!
summary: Gary Lineker's Hot Shot! delivers fast and direct football action from a top-down perspective, with a strong focus on immediate control and fluid play. Because only part of the pitch is visible at any time, it creates a compact and intense feel in which you are constantly switching between attack and defense while quickly taking control of the right player. One of its most appealing aspects is the way shots can be shaped not just in power but also in execution, allowing even spectacular moves to emerge from the right timing and a well-judged input.
